summary: Comprehensive risk assessment for adopting Cimorelli's 4 formatting innovations (output schemas, NEVER/ALWAYS constraints, rich frontmatter, worked examples) across all 106 Antigravity agents. Covers per-innovation risk analysis with specific mitigation strategies, system-wide impact summary table, and a recommended 3-phase rollout workflow (Template+Cimorelli → Top 10 Tactical Agents → Full Rollout). Concludes that no innovation will break existing agents (all additive), but warns against mass batch updates due to quality degradation risk.
